name: next-steps
description: After each turn, shows up to three guessed next prompts (1-3) above the input, then your templates, whose [目标] the same guess fills, and your fixed phrases (from 4). A suggestion or template goes into the prompt box as a draft; a phrase is sent at once; 0 dismisses.

minAnswerChars.title: Shortest answer to suggest after
minAnswerChars.description: Skip suggestions after answers shorter than this many characters.

suggestSkills.title: Suggest skills and slash commands
suggestSkills.description: Tell the suggester which skills and slash commands this session has, so a suggestion can be one of them.

phrases.title: Phrases
phrases.description: Fixed buttons above the prompt that send their text at once when pressed: one entry each, as label|text, or the text alone when it is short.
default: 全部推送|把当前经手的所有工作区提交并推送，最终保证每一个工作区都是干净的。然后检查一下相关的pr还有没有没处理的。

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Buttons whose text holds [目标]: after each turn the suggester fills [目标] from the conversation, the button shows what it guessed, and a press puts the filled text in the prompt box as a draft. One entry each, as label|text.
